blurb: Guests can meet and interact safely with farm animals including goats, sheep, cows, ducks, turkeys, and pigs. The farm offers private tours, socials with baby goats and piglets, and private event rentals with animals. Activities are educational and hands-on, with a focus on animal behavior and farm life.
